This quest leads you to become [[Weh no Su]] (Closer To The Stars).

{{TOCright}}
==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Mhenlo]] and [[Master Togo|Togo]] about how to find the Oracle of the Mists.
* Seek out [[Nika]] in [[Bukdek Byway]].

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 150 [[Gold]]

===Environmental changes===
After completing this quest, Nika and the [[Off-Duty Guard]]s will continue to [[spawn]] in Bukdek Byway, repeating [[#Intermediate dialogue|their dialogue from this quest]] when you approach them, until the follow-up quest, Closer to the Stars, is accepted.

==Walkthrough==
Exit [[Dragon's Throat (outpost)|Dragon's Throat]] into [[Shadow's Passage]] and talk to Brother Mhenlo. Then make your way to Nika in Bukdek Byway. You can either go to Bukdek Byway from Shadow's Passage or [[map travel]] to [[Kaineng Center]], [[The Marketplace]] or [[Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter)]] (if you're playing a foreign character) and start from one of those. 

Either way, proceed to the map marker giving Nika's location; when you approach her, she will begin her scripted dialogue with the Off-Duty Guards who are harassing her. Be careful when you approach her, as there are a number of [[patrol]]ling [[Jade Brotherhood]] groups close by. Careful [[pull]]ing should enable you to dispatch the groups individually, although you will probably find that Nika begins talking while you are fighting.

:'''Brother Mhenlo:''' ''"I heard that Nika saw the Oracle not long ago.  I think I know where she can be found."''

;Brother Mhenlo
:''"Nika was just starting at Shing Jea my last year there, but I got to know her fairly well.  She's an Assassin with the [[Obsidian Flame (guild)|Obsidian Flame]] now and spends her time in '''Bukdek Byway''', I believe.  If anyone can help you find the Oracle of the Mists, she can.  The only trick will be getting her to help you.  She can be a bit willful, and believe me when I say you don't want to make her mad.  Just tell her Master Togo sent you."''

:'''Off-Duty Guard:''' ''"Maybe we should just go.  The Obsidian Flame will get what is coming to them."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Nika
:''"That's right. I'm Nika the Assassin and I am a member of the Obsidian Flame. It does not surprise me that you know my name.  Nor even that you have heard of my exploits becoming Closer to the Stars.  But what I am wondering is why is it any of your affair? Well, are you ready to explain yourself?"''
